\subsection{What the Confidence Score Measures}
\label{sec:experiments-confidence}

% TODO(Task 12): prose. This subsection exists to RETIRE a claim, not to
% support one. Four points, in this order.
%
% 1. THE FRAMING IS NEGATIVE AND MUST STAY NEGATIVE. The detector emits a
%    confidence float on every element and NOTHING GATES ON IT (guardrail 2).
%    This table is the evidence that not gating is the right call. Do not
%    write a sentence that could be read as "the model knows when it is
%    uncertain" -- the measurement says close to the opposite.
%
% 2. THE DISTRIBUTION IS DEGENERATE. 7 distinct values in [0.85, 0.97] over
%    379 elements; the band the prompt reserves for a guess (<0.70) is never
%    used once; the middle band is used 32 times. A score that never exercises
%    two thirds of the range it was given is not carrying information about
%    difficulty.
%
% 3. THE MEDIUM ARTICLES' NUMBER IS RE-MEASURED, AND HALF OF IT IS WRONG
%    (guardrail 4). "85-90% of indicators at 0.95+" reproduces at 89.7%
%    (236/263) -- cite the measurement, never the article. But the SECOND half
%    of that sentence, that the low tail comes from "tables, footnotes, or
%    sections with unusual formatting", is REFUTED: four of six states have no
%    sub-0.95 indicator at all and the tail is essentially all of Kentucky,
%    where every one of the 26 indicators scores below the line. The score
%    moves per DOCUMENT, not per hard passage. The same article's claim of a
%    0.70 review gate is doubly dead -- no such gate exists, and zero elements
%    in the corpus would have tripped it.
%
% 4. KENTUCKY IS THE CLEANEST SINGLE ILLUSTRATION and it belongs in the prose,
%    not the caption. KY is the one state with a detection-exhaustive golden;
%    it scores recall 1.000, code accuracy 1.000 and verified precision 1.000
%    -- the best-evidenced detection in the corpus -- while carrying the
%    LOWEST confidence of any state. CA earns the same recall and code
%    accuracy with all 94 indicators at 0.95+.
%
% ⚠️ Be careful with the one hallucination. It IS the lowest-scoring element,
% and that reproduces across 14 same-configuration runs (966 elements, no
